异蝶碎雨剑最新章节_感谢一路来支持我的所有人第1页_异蝶碎雨剑潇瀮_热点小说网
> 感谢一路来支持我的所有人（第1页）
感谢一路来支持我的所有人（第1页）
这部小说，只要看上三两章得人都会清楚，绝不是瞎写的，是作者辛辛苦苦“千淘万漉”所得。潇瀮对于文笔的要求和人物的刻画是很严格的，遣词酌句细细推敲，描摹刻画刀刀入木。
一年了，我也应该做一个小结了。第一个打赏我的人叫做石杜。我很清楚！至今为止，
有：我来看书的不写书（最多了）、乾坤泰、沐沐格子、大寒尖、戮冷月无情、黎家大少爷、桃源海燕、寰宇神隙、桃花忆、古月科科、白小归、来自星星的尼玛、赛智泰瑞斯、木秋琳、水澜晶、于阡陌、王小三333、楠溪书生、江南灵秀、唐深深、雪灵脂、信渣科不挂、Yunluo的打赏，潇瀮感激不尽！
还有数不清的好朋友如乐乐山人、老井等的点读、拜访！潇瀮真的发自内心的感激你们！
这一年来学到不少东西，在写作方面。我要做一些小小的改动（从这个礼拜一开始）：
第二，每一章3000字以上。（多的时候会有爆发！）大家期待哦！
最后还是那一句话：潇潇子规暮雨，瀮瀮雨雪纷飞——潇瀮敬上！;

宇宙杀神渡劫陨落，重生为地球上的废材少爷，身边还有个貌美如花的未婚妻，这一世，注定不平凡他无心世俗，却成为地下世界的王者他医术无双，让无数人千金难聘他想离开地球，重回浩瀚宇宙，奈何身边美女环绕，拒之不得。叶欢，这个宇宙中的...
我叫孟川，今年十五岁，是东宁府镜湖道院的当代大师兄。...

content_en:
The latest chapter of The Sword of the Extraordinary Butterfly and the Broken Rain_Thanks to everyone who has supported me all the way. Page 1_The Sword of the Extraordinary Butterfly and the Broken Rain by Xiao Lei_Hot Novel Network
>Thank you to everyone who has supported me along the way (page 1)
Thanks to everyone who has supported me along the way (page 1)
Anyone who has read three or two chapters of this novel will understand that it was definitely not written blindly. It was the result of the author's hard work. Xiaohe is very strict about writing style and characterization of characters. He carefully considers the words and sentences, and describes and depicts the details with a knife.
It’s been a year, so I should make a summary. The first person to reward me was named Shi Du. I know it very well! So far,
There are: I come to read books that don’t write books (most of them), Qian Kun Tai, Mu Mu Ge, Da Han Jian, Kill Lengyue Qing Wu, The Young Master of the Li Family, Taoyuan Haiyan, World God Gap, Peach Blossom Memory, Gu Yue Keke, Bai Xiaogui, From the Stars Xiaolei is grateful for the rewards from Nima, Sai Zhiterisi, Mu Qiulin, Shui Lanjing, Yu Qianmo, Wang Xiaosan333, Nanxi Scholar, Jiangnan Lingxiu, Tang Shensen, Xue Lingzhi, Xinzha Kebugua, and Yunluo!
There are also countless good friends such as Leleshanren, Lao Jing, etc. who read and visited! Xiaochen is really grateful to you from the bottom of my heart!
I have learned a lot this year in terms of writing. I'm going to make some small changes (starting this Monday):
Second, each chapter should be more than 3,000 words. (It will explode when there are too many!) Everyone is looking forward to it!
The last sentence is still the same: Xiaoxiaozi is in the dusk rain, and the rain and snow are flying in the sky-Xiao Lei is here! ;
Please do not turn on the browser reading mode, otherwise the chapter content will be missing and the next chapter will not be read.
In your previous life, you looked down upon me? In this life, I will keep you out of reach! Chen Mo, a great monk in the realm of gods, secretly visited the forbidden area with his junior sister. After his death, he was reborn on Earth in his senior year of high school. Chen Mo discovered that the junior sister was actually reborn on the earth a thousand years ago! Chen Mo dismissed his first love in his previous life. The most beautiful woman in her previous life, Chen Mo was adopted as a maid. The enemy in his previous life, Chen Mo destroyed him with one punch. Chasing the little master...
The God of Killing in the Universe fell through a tribulation and was reborn as a good-for-nothing young master on Earth. He also had a beautiful fiancée by his side. In this life, he was destined to be extraordinary. He had no care for the secular world, but he became the king of the underground world. His unparalleled medical skills made countless people unable to hire him. He wanted to leave the Earth and return to the vast universe, but he was surrounded by beautiful women and could not refuse him. Ye Huan, in this universe...
My name is Meng Chuan, I am fifteen years old this year, and I am the contemporary senior brother of Jinghu Taoist Temple in Dongning Prefecture. ...
